# Retained historical inputs

These non-map inputs retain their original bytes and scientific meaning. Their
standalone factories were retired by the four-map catalog cleanup. They are not
runnable with the current source/catalog. Recover the matching files from Git
commit `a18bba2656e08119a52b44166f11a4cc195baadd`; do not replace those worlds with
a current map. The repository ledger `docs/archive/four-map-retirement.json`
records retired map hashes and retained dependent inputs. No original runs,
worktrees or generated results were changed.
